editorial.blurb: A beloved neighborhood institution serving Chinese-Korean fusion cuisine with generous portions, attentive service from longtime staff, and prices that feel wonderfully vintage.
editorial.insiderTip: Order the jjajangmyun (noodles in black bean sauce) or jjamppong (seafood noodle soup)—these Korean-Chinese specialties are what regulars come back for, and the owner, who speaks multiple languages, remembers faithful customers' orders.
